decisions.reason: As a recent sensor module that moved from a mention to its own page and fits the core modular sensing platform, we are inclined to continue it and treat any weak uptake as temporary.
This industrial input module has visible web commitment, clear overlap with the established automation range and newer platform direction, so we would stay with it rather than reverse course quickly.
Although less prominently presented than some other launches, it is still close to the firm's core control and power offering, and prior development and stocking commitments favor persistence.
This 2024 launch is newer and less central than some modules, but because it extends the existing building-block system we would likely give it more time before conceding poor results.
Remote access for wallboxes supports the publicly stated expansion in charging and energy management, so strategic commitment and recent investment make withdrawal unlikely in the coming year.
